comment: Great walk, lots of variation.
Beginning is not great conditions wise, overgrown and some small walkways are torn up but once you pass the first say 500m it opens up, otherwise good trail and no cost to get in.

They actually charge you like 11-12$ bucks to enter. But trails are well maintained and it’s a very easy hike. I went even when it was raining and the way the drainage is set up the path was wet but overall not really muddy. Bring mosquito spray though. Also lots of toads.
That was really great trail.

Really nice loop trail not too difficult. There was not bugs when we went because it was windy just a few mosquitoes nice overlook and forced trails. You can see a creek but most of it’s pretty easy and gravel paved through a forest and then you get to get in the woods, which is the best part.
Beautiful morning hike, I stoped for a little bit on the rocks edges for a sand which. Overall beautiful trail, lots to see, some caverns to explore, just watch out for the muddy parts!!

Good first visit to Rattlesnake Point.  Trails are well maintained.  I wouldn't say it's an easy hike, but still enjoyable.   Some valleys with steep hills to climb your way out of.  Some lookout points with great views too.  You have to pay a fee to visit, but most free trails I've been on don't have washrooms available so I'll take it.
Nice trail. You get views, a boardwalk, a stream
This was amazing, I’m very happy I decided to do this today!
Only a few muddy spots. Nice spring hiking conditions. Pretty gentle streams flowing, a few petit wild flowers, a couple garter snakes were out.
Muddy with icy sections
Perfect place for hiking
My favourite trail
Very good trails. Well maintained.
Nice long hike. Some parts were closed off due to maintenance but it didn't affect the hike. Pretty look outs.

The Trail is easy to moderate depending on the distance. Not a lot of elevation but great for Trail running or walking a dog. The view points are good. There is even a rock climbing area if anyone is interested. The Trail was busy in the afternoon but its limited to the trailheads and view points near the parking lots. It gets quieter after getting a little farther. Many side trails and a big section of the outer loop are closed until further notice. The parking lot is huge with overflow areas. There is entry ticket which includes the parking. Enjoy!

Busy day today! Bit of a line to get in at 12:30, but a lot worse at 3:00 when leaving! 
Did not seem too crowded on the trail.
Trail by Crawford lake gets very narrow, says it isn’t out and back but it does loop if you follow map
A nice trail for mid level hike. The lookout points are a treat at the end of the hike.
nice and easy trail.  the bruce sections were closed for most of it which was disappointing.  it's likely better on those sections and off the well groomed park trail.
Trail was in great condition.   Very easy.
It was a nice experience, although it was quite easy.
Beautiful canopy providing shade in the hot summer months. Signage and trails are well marked. Just a super enjoyable yet moderately challenging hike to make it interesting.
Great hike along the escarpment with some great views.
I saw a snake and the trail was very nice.
A big section of the trail is closed which was unfortunate but otherwise pretty good
Smells like shit at the beginning of- literally like a cess pool - but once u get through it; nice hike.

Reviews said there was free parking at the end of the road- I don’t know where they meant, but there is No Parking signs at the end of Canyon Rd so we had to park at Rattlesnake Point. 
It was not busy, well maintained (watch out for the roots sticking up), beautiful views, and ample shade.
A semi decent hiking trail. It was pretty crowded unfortunately ( it's best to come here in the morning). Great area for rock climbing. The views are definitely breathtaking!
Lots of people on main trail and entrances, barley anyone on the side trails. Amazing place!
Nice and easy well maintained trail with a beautiful green canopy,  blooming trilliums and lots of accessible picnic areas.
Lots of trilliums blooming.
Trail is dry mostly with a few muddy spots. Cliffside portion of trail closed so you miss scenic lookout and have to double back on same trail to trailhead.
Crawford lake older staff unfriendly to African Canadians
Great trail overall lot of uphill and a lot of downhill but also a lot of fun. Great views and washrooms available rattlesnake point will always be tremendous
Classic trail, not too challenging but a nice short hike for a fall morning. Trails are well maintained and signage is very clear and obvious.
fun and easy trail great for beginners

Beautiful trail, lots of beautiful scenery, not difficult, I'd say moderate only because of the few hills throughout the trail. The parking lot was very full but you can park on the side of the roadway.   *As a reminder * PLEASE, PLEASE, PLEASE,  don't leave your trash on the trails. It's disrespectful to the conservation and to others who use the trail. If you can carry your drinks into the trail, you can carry the garbage out. There are multiple garbage cans throughout the trail. Please use the garbage cans provided, not the ground.
Lovely with Crawford Lake at the end
Fees to get in to the Conservation area. Some of the suggested trail to follow is now closed. Some very minor muddy areas but nothing to worrisome. It's as beautiful as it always is.
Great hike, well marked!
Really cool caves, 100% recommend

Amazing trail - 

Difficult level -5 

Great for nature lovers
Easy trail, some rocky terrain, only a few hills.

Great trail! Nice and shady, with stunning views.

Easy to do with dogs!
Lots of rocks and roots.  Wear proper footwear! Cliff edges.  Keep pets leashed and children close.  enjoy!
Good hike
paid 40 after tax for 3 adults, make a reservation to save on payment. Great hike nonetheless.
Beautiful views of the canyon, a nice diversity in terrain if you venture in the Crawford Lake area
A bit muddy at parts but overall clear trail.
Great experience hiking in the snow. The trail is not slippery. Various sections have been improved upon to make it safer for hiking.
Snow covered trails.  Some icy and bumpy sections especially down in the canyon.  But overall pretty good today.  No issues in my trail runners.
Chilly but nice
Rattlesnake is beautiful any time of year. Great space and lots of beautiful terrain packed tightly together
lions park parking lot is closed due to construction.
It’s pretty muddy right now. Make sure to wear boots with good traction.
Great trail - if you are looking for some hilly terrain in the woods! Lovely this time of year!

The blue blazed hiking trail is challenging. There are 2 ways to go down to the canyon and come up.  The canyon trail is easy - flat with not a lot of rocks and roots.  We returned through Rattlesnake Point on the easy path.
Good stuff
Beautiful lookouts.   Wet and buggy in low lands (start of 2nd half)
Nice maintained trail
Really good
very busy on this Thanksgiving Monday.

not good directions for each trail during the hike
but an easy hike
Easy nice trail with the fall colors
Stunning views!
It was quite a relaxing trail. Since it rained the day before I went, some part of the ground was still pretty muddy. There were definitely mosquitos so bring a bug spray if you want to go.
The trail has different terrains & is rocky, definitely gear up well. Its worth a good hike
A moderate hike along the top of the cliffs, dipping down into the valley and back up.
Muddy from earlier rain, lots of mosquitos nearing Crawford! Bring bug repellent
With kids, it took us 2.5 hours. Lots of fun. Not hard at all. Either a straight walk or a mild incline. Only one spot where we had to scramble, but only for a few feet. Keep water and snacks.

A bit muddy in spots, but very clean and well maintained trail. We started early on a Friday morning, so basically had the place to ourselves and it wasn't too hot yet. We used bugspray to fend off the mosquitoes.
The trail looks great. The mosquitoes are pretty bad, particularly in the lower area (swamp). The bad smell is not as frequent as last year, so far.

Nice shade. Perfect weather.
A bit of mosquitoes that require bug spray.
Pretty flat, nicely paved. Lots of cute dogs to see! Not many viewpoints but you're surrounded by forestry so it's pretty shaded and cool on a hot summers day. Definitely bring bug spray.
nice trail, but MAKE SURE you bring musquito spray
Upper part is good, lower part(Bruce trail) too many mosquitoes
Well maintained. Few insects but over all great

Good hike particularly great in the winter. River wasn't completely frozen but managed to walk around. Busy hike at the top where the lookouts are but less busy the further along. Lots of parking and area for picnic
Easy hike with just a little elevation and a few nice views at the start and finish.

Well marked trail with decent foot traffic!! Saw a 
Northern ribbonsnake along the way!
Wednesday Walkin’
Trails were relatively dry, some muddy areas, great conditions otherwise. Busy with the great weather

Trail was well marked. Went at a very leisurely pace and took around 2.5h; the terrain has ups and downs but isn't very challenging. As of Easter weekend, there is still some snow on the ground at certain points, and melt off/ mud in other sections. Ticks are active, so be careful with pets.
Wet and muddy spots.  Slushy and snow in other spots. Not surprising for this time of year though.
Lost connection so the trail Louistor and I did didn't get fully recorded. Same as last time for the maps not lining up with the trails. This place can kiss my ass.
Pretty muddy and slippery at some spots but still a great hike!
Ice/slush/mud - challenging going up and down the steeper slopes - definitely recommend spikes and poles
Great day great conditions
Easy trail with some diverse terrain and beautiful scenery..
Beautiful but too busy
Had to make reservations but there is plenty of parking. Lots of people on the upper part of the trail, weather was gorgeous and colours were spectacular
Beautiful fall day for a hike! Not many people if you arrive early in the morning. Online reservation is required.
Sign is a bit hard to follow so I used all trails navigate option which was great! Gorgeous fall colors and a little busy around the lookouts but very worth the hike
Trails are fairly difficult, views are worth the effort. Must make reservations.
Great out and back hike
You can park at the lower parking lot for closer access to the trail...fairly easy hike to the closest lookout.
Beautiful in the fall! Make sure to make a reservation
Very nice hike
Awesome day for a hike.  The fall colors are just starting to come in!
Trails not signed very well. Careful!
Easy trail and quite busy with traffic.
Nice trail with a great view!
Super fun, we did a mix of buffalo and Bruce, lots of incline but nothing scary.
Lots of forest and a good viewpoint
Okish view. Was expecting more
Beautiful trail, mostly shade and lots of look out points along the Bruce side trails. Lots of mosquitos at times so being bug spray. There are so many more trails to explore too.

Great trail - long, majority shaded, some decent elevation gains and lookouts. We started around 10:30 am and it was already quite busy, but not too bad. Some of the paths are rocky or rooted and could be a bit tricky for folks with mobility issues, while others are very smooth. Be sure to reserve park entry in advance on the website (or just before you enter the park gates).
Nice trail with some flat and wide areas and some rocky and steeper stretches. Only nice views are towards the end.
Trail is well maintenance! not super busy but the 3 hour time limit is limiting if you want to walk all the way to Crawford Lake
Beautiful trail. Some rocky and hilly parts but mostly smooth and easy. A little muddy in some spots.
it was good with the loop. Creek overflowed on the way back and it was next to impossible crossing it. Knee deep water. Everything else was good
It was a great hiking trail. There is a strong smell at the beginning of the hike.
Very nice trail, very well marked and maintained. Slippery in some spots cleats are recommended

Amazing trail with boardwalks and scenic lookouts nearby. This however IS NOT an easy trail at all. Lots of elevation changes, slippery mud, rocks and branches everywhere and tons of uneven surfaces. Definitely bring out the hiking boots for this one.
Moderate trial with great views!
Very enjoyable
Was easy and enjoyable
There are 2 parking lots, upper and lower. Reasonably maintained facilities and trails.
Great trail, high elevations and multiple lookout points with great views
awesome loop. fair elevation at certain points. good shade. not too buggy. didn't see anyone on the west side of the loop. nice boardwalk in the north west portion
A wet and chilly hike through random trails with the wife. Always a great area to explore.
Trail was good - weather was not. Very wet hike but loved it just the same.
Lots of side trails for many difficulty levels. Great escarpment.

One of my favorites.
stan
Good trail with moderate ups and downs.
Wet day but a great hike.

It says the access to the canyon trail is closed but I was just there today and there were no barriers. It was completely open. The trail is gorgeous but it is very muddy right now. I would avoid the canyon trail after a big rainfall but the portions on-top were fine. Highly recommended.
VG overall, only a little ice but lotsa mud.
Great !!!
Excellent fist hike of the new year! Trails a bit icy but we had our new cleats on which were awesome!
A little Icy today.

definitely thankful I had the all trails map. I took a couple of detours but I could definitely take more than 2 hours there, especially in the quiet morning. All the leaves have fallen but there's still something serene about the in-between state of autumn. :)
third time. good walk.
Beautiful fall colors
one of my favorites
Obey
Great
Good views, lot of greens
currently closed   :(   was looking forward to trying this one.

Note the listed distance is from the lower parking lot, which is closed in winter. From the upper lot I did the Bruce side trail down and the Nassagewaya trail back (orange markers) since I had to be at an appointment and it ended up being 8.6k! Alternating sections of mud, ice, snow and slush in early March.
Great for leisurely hike. More on the easy not moderate trail.
Rattlesnake Point is always a pleasure to hike. Worth the $7 entrance fee. The fall colours are beautiful, especially from the many southern lookout points.
Great trail, very busy in spots on a beautiful Sunday afternoon. Some challenging parts makes the trail a lot of fun with the dog.
Good for trail running

it was a great hike on a rainy day. 
smelt pretty bad tho (like as though I was in a gigantic outhouse) I'm not sure if the rain caused the overpowering smell but I left wondering why the heck was so strong and if it was good for me to breathe that for 2+hrs.
good hike tho
Definitely recommend the side trails on this on, mainly due to the high trafficked main trails.  Outside of that it was a decent trail that I will definitely do again!
we rnjoyed this trail a lot, nice lookout, maps and marks are good, one of the favourits now in Halton.
Nice shady hike. Easy
definitely a good workout! lots of mosquitos in the summer so be sure to get bug protection!!
Awesome hike!
I've hiked this trail dozens of times it's a great walk.
hiking
Very busy trail

Interesting trail with some ups and downs, not flat, except for section that runs along the creek - flat lowland, lotsa bugsss. I did it anti-clockwise to end with a good view looking over the cliffs.

This is a well-maintained trail.  I'm over 60 and this trail was easy - no idea how this gets a 'moderate' rating.  There are very few rocks - you don't have to step on any if you don't want to, and there is certainly no required scrambling. The altitude change is very modest and not steep.  Markings on the main trail near the start point are better maintained than secondary trails or the return trip.
Minus the mosquitos, great trail!
good, easy walk

Beautiful hike! It was super busy near the trail head and the lookouts but fewer people further out. There terrain is pretty much the same the entire hike but would definitely recommend it. Not much for wildlife probably because of the volume up people but still worth it!
Not too busy great views. Early spring so not much growth as yet. Did see a turkey vulture. No litter around but it was a bit muddy
Great views! We went in January so there weren’t huge crowds. Maybe a dozen people passed in the 4 hour hike. Would definitely go again.

Out on this trail today with a friend; absolutely beautiful. Definitely very muddy in parts but completely tolerable if you’re wearing proper hiking shoes. Trails are well marked but make sure you’re paying attention and have time to go to Crawford loop - we went out in afternoon and didn’t notice we made wrong turn and ended up in  Crawford trails (only planned on 7.8 loop) - our loop turned into a  16k - we started later in day so we’re worried about losing sunlight. That was our bad though and still a beautiful detour. Look forward to doing this again.
Nice walk!
An incredible view with interesting side trails. Well marked and easy to follow, I'm excited to try it out again!

Well great hike. From rattlesnake to Crawford lake. 13.54 km. But I forgot to turn off the app on the way to dinner. Oooops!

We started early just stopped raining a couple of hours ago. It made no difference, it was an easy hike, yes with some very muddy places between rattlesnake and Crawford lake on the orange trail. But nothing anyone would cry over.  At some points we thought the mud would have eaten our boots. It was just so funny. We did the board walk trail around the lake. It was so nice to hear laughing and giggling all the way to the other side.  
We had lunch and a good break at the visitors area at Crawford centre and we were ready for the return hike. 
Lots of people everywhere, nice to see families even with strollers which I wouldn’t recommend, but everyone was having fun.  At the end skies cleared and were amazing spots for photos.
Beautiful fall colours
A good hike from Crawford lake to Rattlesnake point and back
Loved hiking it during fall and seeing the beautiful autumn leaves. What a pretty hike.
Great nature trail.
Fantastic hiking tails and viewpoints!

Great trail.  Some parts allows for an easy option and a moderate option. Moderate option provided lots of different elevations and terrains. Decent look out views, buildings in the distance we're visible from top of cliffs
Start raining heavily at the beginning of my run, got a little slippery but was still a crest workout with some amazing views.
Lots of fun.

Very nice trail, great view, but lots of lazy idiots littering on the trail. You will find lots of dog poop bags, bottles, and other plastic along the trail; especially near the road areas. The park doesn't put any recycling bins or garbage bins along the trail. It's a real shame....
Great trail, the farther away from the entrance you go the quieter and less busy it gets. It’s nice that once you’re in far enough you can’t hear the highway anymore either.

Way to many people. My fault for venturing out on a Sunday so close to the city.
1st time in Rattlesnake Point.
Meh..
Love the BTC though!
Amazing views, moderately challenging trail, highly recommended!
Nice for an afternoon out
Way too crowded, lots of garbage left around. Actual trail is okay, I need a little more of a challenge , I guess. Nice views of the area.
Beautiful trail with moderate difficulty. Enjoyed it !

Great trail! Clearly marked and adequately challenging. Rocky and muddy at points and crowded at the start of the trails but peaceful and quiet once you get further in. Wonderful experience 10/10 would recommend.
it was an easy hike. beautiful views
Spend the day head all the way to Crawford Lake

Good trail with some very nice views along the way. There are enough ups and downs to get some exercise, but I’d still consider it a very easy trail. It connects to the Bruce Trail, so it’s possible to turn this into a longer hike. It’s nice even during bad weather since there are enough trees to protect you from the rain.
Very nice trail. various side trails of the Bruce rail system in the area also. I'll be trying to to get it again soon.
I really thought it was beautiful

This is a great trail with some very challenging sections and the elevation changes are great.
Very busy, to be expected and a great fall day like today. And of course we want our conservation areas to be busy!

Down side of it being busy? Some sections of the trails are quite narrow in addition to being rocky so the traffic causes some jams.
nice trail... and we can choose different path to go... fun trail...

Good day hike for any fitness level. There was one short side trail that involved a bit of climbing on rocky surface. Scenic views along the way to stop and rest. Took about 3 hours return to finish. Quite crowded once I arrived at Crawford Lake. Better to go early in the morning.
A great walk for any skill level. Great scenic views from the escarpment side. (South west side of trail)
Beautiful - except we got lost and ended up at Crawford Lake.  Signs need to be better.  Maybe we're dumb...it just would be nice to see trail headers everywhere clearly marked.
Beautiful trail and views, easy stroll in the forest. We went on a long weekend and was surprisingly not packed. Will return. Pooch loved it too.
Great trail. Wish the markings were a little clearer as we got lost and never found the lake, but great park overall.

Nice easy trail - slightly busy with dogs and people. Shaded throughout with a couple of nice look out spots. On site parking (note: $7 fee per to enter the park). There is a side trail that takes you over to the Crawford Lake area which is nice if you want to add to the hike and cool off!
Loved the variety of options to hike. Multiple trails and multiple skill levels. Great spot for everything from rock climbing, or just an easy walk with the dog.
Great trails with great views. You can stroll on the easy walkway and keep it short or take to hiking the rockier trails for a little more of a challenge and up to 14km or even more if you like.
Tons of fun
Any age trail dig friendly. Scenic views fresh air.

I love this park/set of trails. It does get busy sometimes, so go there knowing that you'll be sharing the trails with potentially a lot of people. Since I like quiet trails that's the only reason I didn't give a 5/5. It's a beautiful location.
great afternoon walk.
It was amazing me and my girlfriend loved it I would strongly recommend this trail.
Great map. All what you need.
gorgeous scenery. Bruce trail blue section availability. wild turkey vultures. Climbing. Hiking. many benches for resting
Really good distance and good elevations at points.  Funky statue of the a salamander!
This was very fun I got to climbs rocks and the view it great and I loved the little cave thing they had so fun.
great for a family hike on a Sunday morning. lots of great lookout points and lots of benches along the trail for taking a break.
Very flat, but loops so you can get some mileage in before looping back to your car.

Perfect lazy hike on Sunday.  Entered Bruce Trail at Twiss Rd. ended at Appleby Line entrance to the Crawford/Rattlesnake Conservation Area.
Bruce Trail had no traffic, but the Conservation Area was packed!
lots of shade, easy walk .
